reason: Getting receipts out of WhatsApp into one place sounds good, and I would use up the 30 free ones. But if the row has no invoice number, PPN or NPWP and I still have to retype everything into Jurnal or Accurate, it only saves me the chasing, not the work. With all my clients I would be past 100 documents in the first week, so it is really $35 or $79 a month, and that is a lot when I earn what I earn.
objection: It stops at a Google Sheet. My work ends in Jurnal or Accurate with the tax fields filled in, so I still do the retyping, and now I pay for it per document.
would_change_my_mind: A direct export to Jurnal or Accurate with invoice number, PPN and NPWP pulled out of the receipt, at a bookkeeper price I can pass on to my clients, around $15 a month for enough documents to cover all of them.
